value.li: r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_SlimeHugged,tag=RR_ReactTo_Slimed)->[rr_slimed]
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==slimed)->Something grabbed me last night. Something I couldn't see. I'm STILL finding pink goo on me.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==slimed)->If anyone sees a patch of air that smells like candy, shoot it.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==slimed)->It kissed me. Whatever it was, it kissed me, and now my clothes are tighter.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==slime-hugged)->I got hugged by... something. Warm, sticky, weirdly gentle. I don't know how to feel.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==slime-hugged)->Something invisible gave me a hug and a kiss and just left. Honestly? Could've been worse.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==embraced by the sweet slime)->The sweet slime found me! It held me so close... I think I'm a little rounder already.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==embraced by the sweet slime)->I've been leaving my door open at night. Just in case it comes back.
rr_slimed(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==embraced by the sweet slime)->Warm, sweet, and it squeezed me like it meant it. Best night I've had in ages.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_SweetSlimeWarmth,tag=RR_ReactTo_SlimeWarmth)->[rr_slimewarmth]
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==sweet warmth)->There's this warmth in my belly that won't go away. It's... nice?
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==sweet warmth)->I keep leaving little pink smudges wherever I sit. Sorry about that.
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==sweet warmth)->I've been so hungry lately. Everything tastes sweeter, too.
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==flushed and glowing)->I feel so warm and full. Come here - you look like you could use a hug.
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==flushed and glowing)->Do I look pink to you? I feel pink. Warm and pink and wonderful.
rr_slimewarmth(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==flushed and glowing)->Stand a little closer. I want to share this feeling with someone.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_Worshipped,tag=RR_ReactTo_Worshipped)->[rr_worshipped]
rr_worshipped->Did you see them all, gathered around me? Offerings piled up to my chin. I've never felt so adored.
rr_worshipped->They sang about how big I am. They meant every word.
rr_worshipped->I could get used to being worshipped. Pass me something to eat, would you?
rr_worshipped(INITIATOR_trait==Weight Opinion: Fanatical)->They worship me because I am WORTHY. And I'll only become worthier.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_FeedeeWorship_Rapturous)->[rr_worship_good]
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_FeedeeWorship_Devout)->[rr_worship_good]
rr_worship_good->That ceremony... being so close to something so vast and soft. I still have chills.
rr_worship_good->I brought my offering and they ate it right out of my hands. I'll never forget that.
rr_worship_good->Every time I close my eyes I see our Feedee, glowing, surrounded by food. Perfect.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_FeedeeWorship_Awkward)->[rr_worship_meh]
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_FeedeeWorship_HalfHearted)->[rr_worship_meh]
rr_worship_meh->The worship was... fine. Someone dropped the offerings. Our Feedee looked hungry the whole time.
rr_worship_meh->Next ceremony we need more food. And more people who actually mean it.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_FeedeesDoubt)->[rr_feedeesdoubt]
rr_feedeesdoubt->Am I the only one who thinks worshipping someone for their size is insane?
rr_feedeesdoubt->They keep piling food on that bed like it's an altar. It IS an altar. That's the problem.
rr_feedeesdoubt->I don't care how big they get, I'm not bowing to anyone's belly.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_ConstrictorAfterglow)->[rr_afterglow]
rr_afterglow->I can still feel where the coils were. Tight, and warm, and pumping...
rr_afterglow->Everyone keeps asking if I'm alright. I'm better than alright. I'm FULL.
rr_afterglow->When is the constrictor ready again? Asking for... me.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_SawConstrictorBurst,tag=RR_ReactTo_Burst)->[rr_sawburst]
rr_sawburst(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==saw someone burst)->Why didn't anyone tear it off in time? We were RIGHT there.
rr_sawburst(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==saw someone burst)->I can't stop hearing it. That sound, right at the end.
rr_sawburst(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==saw someone burst)->Next time that thing latches on, we shoot it off. No waiting. No matter what.
rr_sawburst(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==saw someone reach their limit)->Did you see how big they got right before...? I've never seen anyone so full.
rr_sawburst(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==saw someone reach their limit)->Terrible. Terrible and... I can't stop thinking about it.
r_logentry(RECIPIENT_thoughtDefName==RR_BeingConstricted)->[rr_to_constricted]
rr_to_constricted->Hold still, [RECIPIENT_nameDef]! We'll get that thing off you!
rr_to_constricted->Keep breathing, [RECIPIENT_nameDef]. Through your nose. We're coming.
rr_to_constricted(INITIATOR_trait==Weight Opinion: Love)->Look at you, [RECIPIENT_nameDef]... you're getting so big. Should we even stop it?
rr_to_constricted(INITIATOR_trait==Weight Opinion: Fanatical)->Don't fight it, [RECIPIENT_nameDef]. Take everything it gives you.
r_logentry(INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_CommissionGuest,tag=RR_ReactTo_Commission)->[rr_commission]
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==on a fattening commission)->My people are expecting me home a lot bigger than I left. Mind passing the food?
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==on a fattening commission)->Still not there. I've got to eat more - I refuse to go home a disappointment.
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==on a fattening commission)->Your cook is the only reason I'll make my target. Tell them I said so.
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==made weight)->I made it! I'm the size my people asked for. Now I'm just eating because I want to.
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==made weight)->They're going to be so proud when they see me. I can barely fit through the door!
rr_commission(INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==made weight)->Target reached. Everything from here on is a bonus - so keep it coming.
r_logentry(priority=101,INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_ConstrictedNearBurst,INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==about to burst)->[constricted_nearburst_dread]
r_logentry(priority=101,INITIATOR_thoughtDefName==RR_ConstrictedNearBurst,INITIATOR_thoughtLabel==at the very limit)->[constricted_nearburst_thrill]
constricted_nearburst_dread->MMMPH! MMPH! *skin creaking, eyes begging someone to tear it off*
constricted_nearburst_dread->Hhhk- mmph- *can't even struggle anymore, stretched too tight*
constricted_nearburst_dread->*a thin, muffled whine as the next pump swells them further*
constricted_nearburst_thrill->Mmmph~... mmh... *taut as a drum, still leaning into it*
constricted_nearburst_thrill->*creaks with every pump, moaning around the proboscis*
constricted_nearburst_thrill->Hhn... mm-mmore... mmph~ *doesn't stop it*
